title: Sum the readings
prompt: Return the sum of all readings; an empty array totals zero.
explanation: The accumulator is overwritten on every pass. Add each reading to keep the running total.

title: Largest value
prompt: Return the largest value in a non-empty array, including when every value is negative.
explanation: Starting at zero beats every negative value. Start from the first element instead.

title: Count the vowels
prompt: Count the vowels in the text, ignoring case.
explanation: indexOf returns 0 for the first vowel, so the check must accept zero. Use >= 0.

title: Average of scores
prompt: Return the exact average of the scores as a double.
explanation: Dividing two ints truncates the fraction. Convert one operand to double first.

title: Reverse the text
prompt: Return the characters of the text in reverse order.
explanation: The loop stops before index 0, dropping the first character. Include index 0.

title: Palindrome check
prompt: Return true when the text reads the same backwards, ignoring case and punctuation.
explanation: == compares object identity, and the reversed string is a new object. Compare the contents with equals.

title: Binary search
prompt: Return the index of the target in a sorted array, or -1 when it is missing.
explanation: The loop quits while one candidate is still unchecked. Keep searching while low <= high.

title: Unique values in order
prompt: Return the values with duplicates removed, keeping the first occurrence order.
explanation: Set.add returns true only for a new value. Keep the value when add succeeds, not when it fails.

title: Count the words
prompt: Count the words in a sentence separated by any amount of whitespace.
explanation: Splitting on a single space turns repeated spaces into empty words. Split on one or more whitespace characters.

title: All scores equal
prompt: Return true when every score in the list is the same value.
explanation: For boxed Integers, != compares references and only looks right for small cached values. Compare with equals.

title: Remove the negatives
prompt: Return a copy of the list without its negative numbers.
explanation: Removing from the list you are iterating throws ConcurrentModificationException. Iterate the original and edit the copy.

title: Caesar shift
prompt: Shift lowercase letters by the given amount, wrapping around the alphabet; the shift may be negative.
explanation: The % operator keeps the sign of the dividend, so a negative shift goes below zero. Use Math.floorMod to wrap.

title: Count occurrences
prompt: Return how many times the target appears in the list of words.
explanation: get returns null for a word that has not been counted yet, and unboxing it throws NullPointerException. Default to zero.

title: Shout it
prompt: Trim the text, convert it to upper case and add an exclamation mark.
explanation: Strings are immutable, so toUpperCase returns a new string that this line throws away. Assign the result.

title: Total bytes
prompt: Return the total number of bytes for the file sizes, which can exceed the int range.
explanation: An int accumulator overflows silently before it is widened to long on return. Accumulate in a long.

title: Smallest value
prompt: Return the smallest value in a non-empty array.
explanation: Starting at zero hides every positive value. Start from the first element.

title: Count even numbers
prompt: Count how many numbers in the array are even.
explanation: The test counts odd numbers. An even number leaves a remainder of 0.

title: Clamp a value
prompt: Limit the value to the range from low to high.
explanation: Values above the range should be capped at the upper bound, not the lower one.

title: Factorial
prompt: Return n! for n of zero or more.
explanation: The loop never multiplies by n itself. Include n in the range.

title: Last letter
prompt: Return the last non-space character of the text, or ? when the text is blank.
explanation: Valid indexes end at length - 1, so charAt(length) is out of bounds.

title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
prompt: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
explanation: 9 / 5 is integer division and equals 1. Use a floating-point ratio.

title: Count a character
prompt: Count how many times the character appears in the text.
explanation: The condition counts every other character. Count the characters that equal the target.

title: Is it sorted?
prompt: Return true when the array is in ascending order.
explanation: The last pass reads values[length], past the end of the array. Stop before the length.

title: Sum of squares
prompt: Return the sum of the squares of the values.
explanation: Multiplying by 2 doubles the value instead of squaring it. Multiply the value by itself.

title: Leap year
prompt: Return true for leap years: divisible by 4, except centuries that are not divisible by 400.
explanation: A year divisible by 4 is a leap year, but this returns true for the years that are not.

title: Fibonacci number
prompt: Return the n-th Fibonacci number, where fibonacci(0) is 0 and fibonacci(1) is 1.
explanation: After n steps the value we want is in previous; current is already one step ahead.

title: Contains, ignoring case
prompt: Return true when the text contains the part, ignoring letter case.
explanation: Only the text is lowered, so a search term with capitals never matches. Lower the term too.

title: Remove a value
prompt: Return a copy of the list without the first occurrence of the target value.
explanation: With an int argument, remove(int) deletes by index. Box the value to remove by content.

title: Rotate left
prompt: Return a new array with the values rotated left by k positions.
explanation: Writing to (i + k) rotates the values right. Read from (i + k) to rotate left.

title: Balanced parentheses
prompt: Return true when every parenthesis is closed in the right order.
explanation: A closing parenthesis before any opening one must fail immediately, even if the counts match at the end.

title: Apply a discount
prompt: Reduce the price by the percentage and round to two decimals.
explanation: percent / 100 is integer division and becomes 0, so no discount is applied. Divide by 100.0.

title: Value after the equals sign
prompt: Return the text after the first = sign, or an empty string when there is none.
explanation: substring(at) still includes the = sign. Start one character later.

title: Count pairs
prompt: Count the pairs of different positions whose values add up to the target.
explanation: Starting j at i pairs each value with itself. A pair needs two different positions.

title: Capitalize words
prompt: Capitalize the first letter of every word.
explanation: The flag is inverted: only the character after a space should start a new word.
tests: assert capitalize("hello big world").equals("Hello Big World");

title: Total length
prompt: Add up the lengths of the items; null entries count as zero.
explanation: Calling length on a null entry throws NullPointerException. Skip null items.

title: Sort ascending
prompt: Return the values sorted in ascending order, for any int values.
explanation: Subtracting two ints can overflow and flip the sign. Use Integer.compare for the comparison.
tests: assert Arrays.equals(sortAscending(new int[]{Integer.MAX_VALUE, -5, 3}), new int[]{-5, 3, Integer.MAX_VALUE});

title: Split into chunks
prompt: Split the list into consecutive chunks of the given size; the last chunk may be shorter.
explanation: The final chunk ends past the list size, which throws. Clamp the end index to the size.

title: Tier bonus
prompt: Return 50 points for gold, 20 for silver, 5 for bronze and 0 for anything else.
explanation: Without break, silver falls through into the bronze case and receives both bonuses.

title: Same total
prompt: Return true when the prices add up to the expected total.
explanation: Floating-point sums such as 0.1 + 0.2 are not exactly 0.3. Compare with a small tolerance.

title: Initials
prompt: Return the upper-case initials of the first and last name followed by a dot, such as AL.
explanation: Adding two chars is numeric addition, so a + b produces a number. Start the expression with a string.

title: Major version
prompt: Return the major number of a version string such as 3.4.1.
explanation: split takes a regular expression where . matches any character. Escape the dot to split on it literally.

title: Bucket index
prompt: Map a key to a bucket index from 0 up to buckets - 1; it must never be negative.
explanation: Math.abs(Integer.MIN_VALUE) is still negative. floorMod always returns a value in range.

title: Drop the evens
prompt: Return a copy of the list without its even numbers.
explanation: Removing an element shifts the rest left, so a forward loop skips the next one. Walk backwards.

title: Score of a player
prompt: Return the player score, or 0 when the player is missing or the score is not positive.
explanation: get returns null for a missing player, and unboxing it in the comparison throws. Check for null first.

title: Longest word
prompt: Return the longest word; when several share the length, return the first one.
explanation: With >= a later word of equal length replaces the earlier one. Use a strict comparison to keep the first.
